title: Expected value of a random 3-SAT assignment
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set of Boolean variables, and let a 3-SAT instance have a nonempty multiset of clauses, with every variable occurring in some clause. If each variable is assigned an independent uniform Boolean value, then the expected fraction of satisfied clauses, counting multiplicities, is $7/8$.
hypotheses_covered: every variable occurs in the scope of some clause
the instance uses the specified 3-SAT template
the assignment is independently and uniformly sampled over Boolean values
